L9: # Title:Local Reflexivity and Exactness for Reduced $C^*$-Algebras of Wreath Products
L10: 
L11: Authors:【5†Pingchuan Dong】, 【6†Zhe Dong】
L12: 
L13: View a PDF of the paper titled Local Reflexivity and Exactness for Reduced $C^*$-Algebras of Wreath Products, by Pingchuan Dong and Zhe Dong
L14: 
L15: 【7†View PDF】 【8†HTML (experimental)】
L16: > Abstract:We prove that, for every countable non-exact discrete group $H$ and every nontrivial countable discrete group $K$, the reduced group $C^*$-algebra $C_r^*(K\wr H)$ is not locally reflexive. These provide the first known examples of non-locally reflexive reduced group $C^*$-algebras, settling a longstanding existence question.
L17: Moreover, for every nontrivial countable exact discrete group $K$, we establish that local reflexivity of $C_r^*(K\wr H)$ is equivalent to exactness of $H$, and hence to exactness of $C_r^*(K\wr H)$. This gives a partial affirmative answer to Kirchberg's question of whether local reflexivity implies exactness for $C^*$-algebras.
L18: As applications, we construct finitely generated groups with the Haagerup property, as well as finitely generated residually finite groups, whose reduced group $C^*$-algebras are not locally reflexive. In particular, neither the Haagerup property nor coarse embeddability into Hilbert space guarantees local reflexivity of the associated reduced group $C^*$-algebra.
